summary.text: Rick Williams, a Republican, has served in the Georgia State Senate since 2022, representing Senate District 25.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Williams is a native of Barnesville who graduated from Baldwin County High School in 1970 and co-owns multiple funeral service businesses, including Williams Funeral Homes of Milledgeville.

The biography says Williams previously served on the Baldwin County Commission, was Chief Registrar of Baldwin County for 16 years until 2016, and then represented House District 145 in the Georgia House of Representatives.
